x_attribution.analyst_notes: This attribution applies to the broader scheme/ecosystem, not every vendor-specific cluster name.

objects.name: Famous Chollima
objects.description: FAMOUS CHOLLIMA is a CrowdStrike-tracked DPRK-nexus adversary associated with fraudulent remote IT-worker infiltration. CrowdStrike reports that the adversary uses AI-enhanced personas and front companies to obtain remote employment and generate revenue that is funneled to the North Korean regime.
goals: CrowdStrike states that FAMOUS CHOLLIMA's IT-worker infiltration is primarily financially motivated and generates revenue for the North Korean regime.

x_attribution.assessment: CrowdStrike consistently describes FAMOUS CHOLLIMA as a DPRK-nexus adversary; its IT-worker revenue generation supports the North Korean regime.
x_attribution.analyst_notes: CrowdStrike explicitly categorizes FAMOUS CHOLLIMA activity as state-sponsored and reports that its revenue supports the North Korean regime. A specific government unit is not asserted.

x_free_text.history: CrowdStrikeは2024〜2026年にかけてFAMOUS CHOLLIMAのIT-worker/insider型活動の拡大を継続報告している。
